scope: Three frozen workloads, sequential net and independent source reference, uninterrupted and killed/reopened attempts; same explicit grants and Redb durability within each cohort.
build_profile: Cargo test dev/unoptimized; not a release-performance claim

heaptrack.instrumentation: LD_PRELOAD on only the exact worker process; final process exits gracefully before interpretation
heaptrack.precision: Heaptrack heap/RSS display strings are rounded SI values; allocation-call counts are integers; /proc VmHWM is separately recorded in KiB.
heaptrack.excluded: Killed first-process profiler traces are truncated and excluded from complete allocation totals. Retry timing and phase diagnostics still include that attempt. Whole-worker allocation counts are not per-evaluation arena counts.

redactions: Dropped heaptrack_raw_private paths; private raw addresses and process roots remain outside the repository. Canonical receipt frames are unchanged.

rows.allocation_scope: receipt allocated/reused/freed slots are logical arena events, not total process allocation counts
rows.heaptrack_scope: optional separately instrumented worker lifetime; only the gracefully exited final process is complete; raw addresses stay in the operator's private directory
rows.logical_counter_scope: final accepted receipt only; killed uncommitted receipt is not reconstructed; interrupted work is retained in runtime phase diagnostics
rows.memory_scope: Linux whole-worker VmHWM includes initialization, runtime, retained state and all attempts; not per-evaluation allocator instrumentation
rows.preparation_scope: CLI manifest/compile plus canonical identity verification; not isolated producer compile time
rows.qualification: actual same-host separate processes; frozen producer performance NO-GO preserved; no adoption/speedup claim
rows.timing_scope: diagnostic wall/phase observations only; not canonical receipt fields; no timing pass threshold
